LanguageData.LP_DungeonMaster.label: Talia the Dungeon Master
LanguageData.LP_DungeonMaster.description:
Talia sits behind her screen with a stack of notes and a bag of dice at hand. She tells stories with the classic rising-and-falling rhythm: pressure, then a breather, then more pressure.

She favors the adventures of this world: giant migrations, bards, dragon flyovers, abyssal whispers, blasphemers, falling wizard towers... on average she adds an extra DND campaign event every 3 days.

Every 5 days she rolls the dice of fate (d20): a 1 brings a great disaster (a true dragon, a portal out of control, etc.), 2-5 a minor trouble, 16-19 something good and an inspiration, and a natural 20 grants three more inspirations, adventurer XP and a magic item.
